profile.summary:
Full Stack Engineer || Javascript (React-Redux), Typescript, Graphql, Python, Php, Redis, SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead the redesign of the Photo Detail Entry Page. This included discussing requirements with the product team, setting up the React, Redux and React-Router-Dom architectural framework, coordinating with stakeholders and executing on creating the UI

- Wrote REST and Graphql API endpoints with real-time persist product and saves data that internal teams and external partners like HGTV can hook onto at all times

- Set up the architectural framework for the Discovery secondary page, leveraged React Observer to create an infinite scroll

Web Performance Lead: Set up real-time monitoring systems, analyzed performance metrics to create performance roadmaps, resulting in improved speed index by 980ms and reduced Javascript bundle size by  20+%

System Stability: Set up a system stability workshop regarding Jest testing, and implemented tracking test coverage across the team

Mentorship: Mentored and provided technical support to 30+ new hires on app and system design, MVC structuring, PHP and React

positions.title: General Manager / Web Specialist
positions.description:
•	Executed bi-monthly email campaigns using HTML and managed e-commerce platforms that resulted in a 50% subscriber increase in the span of 1.5 years. Drove 5x uplift in e-commerce orders

•	Developed pricing and distribution strategies based on monthly store logistics parsed through SQL

•	Lead bi-monthly financial report presentations and conducted product launch workshops

•	Tracked inventory and finances for over 30 vendor and 10,000 client accounts using Excel and Quickbooks

•	Effectively negotiated multiple vendor contracts that lead to increased profit margins

•	Buyer for handbags, accessories and shoes

honors.title: 1st Place Tech Lead - SF FW 2017 Disrupt Hackathon
honors.description:
Placement: 1st
Built in 24 hours

Implemented Volare API Webhook POST connection to a Rails backend with user data during Wi-Fi login with QR code assignment to user.
Attached server to React Native-based front end with cross-platform Android and iOS tablet functionality for retail company scalability using different devices. 
Designed back-end search engine using relational database mapping with clothes' tag info.


https://cloud4wi.com/sffw2017-hackathon/

========================================

/ Challenge # 1: Customer Engagement
Solutions that enable retailers to connect with shoppers using in-store.
/ Challenge # 2: In-store Operations
Solutions that enable store managers to welcome shoppers and provide them with the best assistance
/ Challenge # 3: Business Intelligence
Solutions that enables retailers to analyze customer insights and predict behavior patterns.

Build a team + Connect w/ other creatives to build an app or a startup company....No other city embraces the intertwined relationship between fashion, retail, technology, and the future of Virtual Reality more than San Francisco does. With the city being known as the hub where technology and fashion intermix... the goal is to create an innovative app to tackle various challenges to foster growth in the local or global fashion industries. Teams will learn from mentors about industry issues and what solutions are relevant.
honors.issuer: Issued by Disrupt Fashion Hackathon 4.0 | Cloud4Wi · Sep 2017

projects.title: Woven
projects.description:
Woven is an iOS mobile application connecting two close friends or a romantic couple through engaging, interactive experiences and a shared digital space.

This project is built on MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React Native, Node.js), which allows for quick development through both client-sided and server-sided JavaScript and JSON object notation. Express.js and Node.js on the back-end provides easy data storage and fetching through custom API routes. Also, MongoDB used along with Mongoose provides simple schemas in a NoSQL document-style database. On the front-end, React Native is used for modular and uni-directional data flow, resulting in high initial velocity for mobile applications like Woven.

FEATURES:
- grow a virtual plant together with your partner
- send hidden messages that pop up when your partner interacts with the plant
- real-time instant messages via socket.io
- shared to-do list that simplifies day to day activities such as grocery run, planning a trip together, & more!
- anniversary reminder

AVAILABLE ON THE APP STORE
